The main missing piece is hard evidence that the inherited Gaza, Ukraine, and Iran/Korea security situations were all left materially calmer by the end of 2024; the record instead shows partial stabilization plus continued high-risk conflict.","evidence":[{"title":"Secretary Blinken’s Meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"2024-05-01","url":"https://2021-2025.state.gov/secretary-blinkens-meeting-with-israeli-prime-minister-netanyahu-4/","summary":"The administration publicly pushed an immediate Gaza ceasefire tied to a hostage deal, stressed humanitarian aid, urged Israel not to widen the conflict, and said it wanted a lasting, sustainable peace.
